name: B10-0264/2025 (PPE) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Tanzania's arrest of opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who faces a possible death sentence for treason, and asks Tanzania to release him and give him a fair trial. It also asks Tanzania to let opposition parties work freely, to hold talks on electoral reform, and to let the European Union and the United Nations watch the case.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests to Tanzania, not binding rules.
- **Who it affects:** Tanzania's government, Tundu Lissu, and opposition parties and journalists there.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to Tanzania, the African Union and the European Union's foreign policy chief; the European Union may watch the situation and consider measures.
